name: status-update
description: Report status as two living HTML pages instead of a long chat message. One project writes .status/project.json; the skill renders that project's STATUS.html, derives its row on the portfolio dashboard at ~/Dev/STATUS.html, opens the page and replies in two lines. Built from 2,400 real status reports, so the zones are what agents already write — including the self-correction block nine mining lanes independently found to be the most consistent section after the headline.
